verdict.rationale: Morph is a token-billed API platform, so spending caps and budget alerts are a fair question for it. The evidence mentions only token billing and rate limits (morph-docs-16), plus cost-reduction features such as half-price batch jobs and free prefix caching. Rate limits are an adjacent control, not a spending cap or budget alert, so they earn no credit. No documented spend caps, budget thresholds or billing alerts appear in the pack.
